description: Start a Verus daemon instance. This is a system command that spawns a new process — it is NOT an RPC call to an existing daemon. The daemon runs independently of this MCP server (detached process). After starting, the tool waits briefly and verifies the daemon launched successfully via getinfo. Call refresh_chains after a successful start so other MCPs can discover the new daemon.

bootstrap.description: Start with -bootstrap flag for faster initial sync. Only useful on first start or after a long time offline. Default: false.

chain.description: Chain to start. Omit for VRSC mainnet. For other chains, provide the chain name (e.g., "vrsctest"). Maps to the -chain= flag.

extra_args.description: Additional command-line arguments passed to verusd (e.g., ["-reindex"]).

name: verusd
